The Solution Lead Secured Connectivity steers Telenet Business' connectivity+ product domain for the SME segment with scalable needs. You own the product domain end-to-end across Fixed Connectivity, Networking (security), scalable SD-WAN and Managed WiFi. You will be combining product backlog, product P&L and people leadership of a multi-disciplinary team of around four product professionals. The Solution Lead Secured Connectivity operates at the boundary between operator-style standardisation and integrator-style configuration, with security as a critical capability layer.

Secured Connectivity is the cluster's most technically nuanced product domain standardised and catalogue-based at its core, but with meaningfully higher configuration than pure telco products and a partner/integrator landscape that demands disciplined vendor management. The cybersecurity boundary with BEAT (where shared platforms and security tooling live) is a critical interface to manage. You will be measured on acquisition & cross-sell into the connectivity base, on ARPU uplift through secured-connectivity attach rates and on the discipline with which deviations from the standard product are governed

 

Your responsibilities as Solution Lead Secured Connectivity

 
• You own the product roadmap and the product P&L for the assigned domain. You steer ARPU, net adds, lifecycle cost and the build-versus-buy-versus-partner decisions, and you oversee the financial lifecycle including capex/opex steering and the operational order flow with vendors and partners.
 
• You lead, coach and develop a multi-disciplinary team. As a Solution Lead Secured Connectivity you will set the ways of working (OKRs, agile rituals, governance cadence) and you build the team's technical and commercial maturity.
 
• You translate business needs and CVP priorities (in collaboration with CVP and CX team) into feasible technical solutions together with Product Managers and business Architects. You drive solution feasibility through Quarterly Business Review (QBR) and Big Room Planning (BRP), and you formulate MVP and scale-up decisions.
 
• You own the product backlog. You prioritise features and epics, validate the “definition of ready” at initiative and epic level, drive EPIC-authoring and ensure clean handovers to build, UAT, FUT and operational readiness.
 
• You own the vendor and partnership strategy for the domain (selection decisions, partnership investments, vendor performance, certifications) and you propose pricing and commercial terms in alignment with the pricing Manager and Tribe Operations & Steering.
 
• You govern technical and operational deviation requests raised by the Commercial Tribe's pre-sales teams, deciding what can be accommodated within the product model and what not. You manage the product/pre-sales interface as a critical handoff, and you ensure your team delivers product-introduction training to pre-sales, sales and customer-facing teams.
 
• 
  
You identify dependencies between tribes and domains (BEAT, Commercial, Enterprise Solutions, Delivery & Services, TV Transformation, CVP & CX), mediate conflicts, drive consensus and escalate in time to the Cluster Lead and Tribe Lead.

  
 

Our ideal Solution Lead Secured Connectivity

 
• You combine technical depth with commercial product accountability, relevant platforms, applications and network technology, with hands-on product management experience (lifecycle, pricing, market positioning, go-to-market).
 
• You have a Master / Engineering / ICT degree (or equivalent through experience) and 8+ years in telecom or ICT, of which a minimum of 3 years in a (digital) product owner or senior product management role.

• You have demonstrated 
 experience leading a multi-disciplinary team of at least 4 senior or specialised professionals: coaching, hiring, performance management and talent development of your direct reports.

scaled-agile ways of working (SAFe, scrum, PI Planning, scrum-of-scrums) and you bring them to life as a working method, not as ceremony. You own scope, time and budget. 

• You are data-driven and comfortable steering on hard KPIs (ARPU, net adds, churn, time-to-activate) and soft signals (rNPS, VOC), and you combine both with frontline customer signals coming back from Commercial. You own the product P&L of your products. 

• You operate effectively across complex stakeholder landscapes, both internal (BEAT, Architecture, Operations, Commercial, CVP & CX, TV Transformation) and external (vendors, partners, engineering, system integrators, ...). You are a bridge builder and know how to work together with other teams to deliver on your products, your financial plan and backlog 

• You are a decisive simplifier who reduces complexity in portfolio choices and ways of working — and you take calls under uncertainty and stand behind them. You take and own your mandate. 

• You are fluent in Dutch (or French) and English, both spoken and written.

About the roleYou'll take ownership of Agile delivery effectiveness across one or more defence software Squads, working at the intersection of Product, Engineering and business stakeholders to turn complex priorities into predictable, sustainable delivery.This is a permanent role in a Spotify-inspired organisation (Squads, Chapters, Tribes), where Senior Scrum Masters contribute not only to team success, but also to the continuous improvement of delivery practices across the wider organisation.You'll operate in a multi-Squad environment with dependencies spanning engineering, product, documentation and customer-facing teams. The role extends beyond a single Squad and requires the ability to influence outcomes across organisational boundaries.

Your Mission

What you'll do

• Create the conditions for effective delivery, ensuring Agile events, stakeholder interactions and team collaboration help Squads make informed decisions, maintain momentum and deliver valuable outcomes.
• Coach Squads, Product stakeholders and leadership, helping them apply Agile thinking pragmatically rather than mechanically.
• Identify, manage and remove impediments, risks and dependencies that impact delivery performance.
• Partner with Market Product Managers to strengthen backlog refinement, sprint readiness and roadmap execution, while ensuring priorities, dependencies and delivery constraints remain visible.
• Collaborate with Tech Writers to ensure documentation activities are planned and aligned with delivery objectives.
• Use delivery insights and Agile metrics to improve predictability, transparency and sustainable ways of working.
• Coordinate with Scrum Masters, Chapters and stakeholders to resolve cross-team dependencies and systemic delivery challenges.
• Mentor less experienced Scrum Masters and contribute to the continuous improvement of Agile practices across ILIAS.
What success looks like

Your Squads deliver valuable outcomes predictably and sustainably, while collaboration across teams continues to improve. Product, Engineering and business stakeholders understand priorities, risks and dependencies early enough to act on them rather than react to them.Teams take ownership of their commitments and continuously improve how they work, using Agile practices as tools for delivery rather than goals in themselves.Stakeholders trust delivery forecasts because expectations are clear, communication is transparent and progress is visible.

What you bring

• 5+ years working in Agile software delivery environments, with substantial experience as a Scrum Master or a comparable Agile delivery or coaching role.
• Strong practical understanding of Scrum, Agile and Lean principles.
• Experience coaching teams and stakeholders to improve collaboration, delivery effectiveness and ways of working.
• Proven ability to facilitate complex discussions, resolve impediments and navigate competing priorities.
• Experience influencing delivery across multiple teams, programmes or organisational domains, balancing team autonomy with broader business objectives.
• Demonstrated ability to improve organisational delivery effectiveness, not only team-level performance.
• Strong communication, facilitation and stakeholder management skills.
• Professional working proficiency in English.
• Eligibility to obtain and maintain the required national or NATO security clearance for this role.
ILIAS Solutions supports candidates through the clearance process and is happy to explain what is involved before you apply.If you meet most of the above, we encourage you to apply. The security-clearance eligibility requirement is not flexible.

 

Nice to have

• PSM II, PSM III, A-CSM, CSP-SM, SAFe Scrum Master or a comparable certification.
• Experience working in a Spotify-inspired organisation with Squads, Chapters and Tribes.
• Experience supporting multiple Agile teams within a complex software environment.
• Familiarity with Agile reporting, delivery forecasting and continuous improvement practices.
• Experience with Jira or similar Agile delivery tools.
• Previous mentoring or coaching experience.

Responsibilities

• Develop and maintain software components using .NET Framework and .NET Core.
• Design scalable technical solutions in collaboration with the architecture team.
• Provide technical coaching and mentorship to team members to foster excellence.
• Conduct code reviews and ensure compliance with development best practices.
• Translate functional requirements into technical solutions alongside business analysts.
• Optimize system performance while ensuring security and maintainability.
• Evaluate and integrate new technologies aligned with business objectives.

Requirements

• You have 8+ years of development experience with .NET Core and .NET Framework.
• You bring 8+ years of experience working with Agile methodologies.
• You possess 3+ years of experience with Blazor and Entity Framework.
• You have 3+ years of experience working with REST APIs and SQL.
• You bring 3+ years of experience in security and identity management using JWT, OIDC, and claims.
• You possess 3+ years of expertise in unit testing and integration testing.
• You have 1+ years of experience utilizing GitHub Copilot.
• You're proactive with strong technical leadership, analytical thinking, and a solution-oriented mindset.
• You are fluent in French or Dutch with a professional command of English.
Nice to Haves

• Willingness to explore and integrate emerging Microsoft technologies.

jobs.description:
Are you a Software Tester with a keen eye for detail and a passion for quality?

For one of our clients in the financial services sector, we are looking for a motivated and analytical Medior Software Test Engineer with 3–5 years of professional experience.

You will join a dynamic IT environment where you will play a key role in ensuring the quality, reliability and functionality of banking applications.

You will collaborate closely with Developers, Business Analysts, UX/UI Specialists and other IT professionals within an Agile/Scrum environment.

What Will You Be Doing?

As a Software Test Engineer, you will ensure that applications meet functional requirements, acceptance criteria and business expectations.

Your key responsibilities:

• Analyse business requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria.
• Design, document and execute functional test cases and test scenarios.
• Identify, analyse, report and track software defects throughout their lifecycle.
• Collaborate with Developers and Business Analysts to investigate and resolve issues.
• Validate application functionality against business requirements.
• Monitor testing activities and software development progress.
• Actively participate in Scrum ceremonies, daily stand-ups and team meetings.
• Contribute to product backlog discussions and prioritisation.
• Work with testers across different teams to continuously improve testing processes.
• Contribute to the overall quality and reliability of financial applications.

What Are We Looking For?

• 3–5 years of professional experience in software testing or functional testing.
• Hands-on experience with Jira, Xray or similar test management tools.
• Good knowledge of SQL and data validation techniques.
• Experience designing, executing and documenting test cases.
• Strong understanding of defect management and bug tracking.
• Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and software development processes.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail.
• Proactive, independent and collaborative mindset.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
• Good professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken.
Nice to have:

• Previous experience in banking, investment or financial services.
• Understanding of financial products and banking applications.
• Experience improving testing processes and quality standards.

Your expertise in the Belgian insurance market, on a long-term assignment with a software vendor serving the country’s leading insurers.

Business Analyst Insurance | Freelance | Brussels

Our client is an international software vendor whose insurance division develops a modular solution covering the entire insurance value chain: distribution, policy management, claims and accounting.

What makes it stand out? A human-sized Belgian team on the insurance side, backed by an international organisation and by product and development teams of several thousand people.

The Belgian market is a strategic priority for the group, which already counts major clients there. Contracts are signed for long periods, often around ten years, giving freelancers real continuity of assignment.

With a growing project portfolio, the company is looking for several freelance Business Analysts specialised in insurance.

All of this within a hybrid and flexible organisation, anchored in Brussels.

The job

• Assigned to a client project, you hold a central role between the insurer, its business teams and the vendor’s engineering teams.
• Understand the client’s needs, challenge them and match them against the capabilities of the solution.
• Analyse the gap between the client’s processes and the standard product, then identify the required configurations or customisations.
• Work on one or more modules depending on your specialisation: group life, individual life, non-life, and potentially claims or finance.
• Be operational from day one and bring your knowledge of the Belgian market straight into the project.
 
Role
• Gather, analyse and challenge the business needs of insurance clients.
• Carry out the gap analysis between the client’s processes and the standard functionalities of the solution.
• Identify and formalise the configurations and customisations to be implemented.
• Translate business needs into clear functional requirements that engineering teams can work with.
• Ensure the day-to-day link between the client’s business stakeholders and the product and development teams.
• Work within your area of specialisation: group life, individual life or non-life insurance.
• Support the configuration and implementation of the solution throughout the project.
• Take part in functional validation and testing of delivered developments.
• Relay Belgian market developments and client expectations to the product teams.
• For the most specialised profiles, contribute to modules deployed across several clients.
Profile
• Freelancer with experience directly tied to the Belgian insurance market: banking experience alone is not sufficient for this role.
• Around 5 to 10 years of business experience, with the ability to be operational immediately, without a training period.
• Proven expertise in one specialisation: group life insurance (including employee benefits), individual life or non-life.
• Experience with an insurer, with a consultancy active in the sector, or with a software vendor specialised in insurance.
• Good knowledge of developments in the Belgian market, particularly local legislation and insurers’ expectations.
• Ability to translate these business stakes into concrete requirements for engineering teams.
• Excellent interpersonal skills and ease with a wide range of stakeholders, from business teams to management.
• Full autonomy and the ability to take ownership of your scope from the start.
• English is essential for working with the international teams, complemented by French or Dutch depending on the client.

The employer is a dynamic and growing organisation operating within a modern commercial and operational environment. Bringing together various services, activities and partners on one site, the company relies on strong internal coordination to ensure smooth day-to-day functioning. To support this mission, it is looking for an Office Manager who will play a key role in the operational and administrative management of the location.

Jobomschrijving

The Office Manager acts as a central point of coordination for the Technical Director and supports various operational teams across the shopping centre.Administrative Management She/he manages internal and external communications, prepares and reviews documents, maintains updated tenant information, circulates weekly footfall data to the Landlord, the Property Manager and the internal team, and organises meetings and conferences. She/he also manages agendas, appointments and administrative workflows.Coordination She/he collaborates closely with internal departments, external partners and tenants to ensure fluid communication and the smooth running of ongoing projects. Responsibilities include drafting meeting minutes, monitoring deadlines, managing office supplies, and overseeing the Info Desk schedule, orders and administrative tasks, including basic support with SUMUP-related matters.Reception & Customer Relations As a representative of the shopping centre, she/he welcomes visitors, partners and clients in a warm and professional manner and provides clear, accurate information regarding the centre's services and activities.Information Management She/he maintains all records, files and databases, ensures confidentiality and data security, oversees the publication and updates of House Rules on Chainels and manages internal communication such as "What's Up" on Chainels.Support to Management She/he assists the Facility Manager with follow-up on files such as security and insurance, prepares ad hoc reports and summaries to support decision-making and provides occasional support to the marketing team when needed.

The ideal candidate demonstrates professionalism, discretion and strong organisational abilities.Key criteria include:

• A flexible and hands-on approach.
• A degree in Business Administration, Secretarial Studies or a related field.
• Previous experience in an Executive Assistant, Office Manager or similar role; experience in a shopping-centre environment is a strong asset.
• Excellent organisational, prioritisation and time-management skills.
• Strong proficiency in MS Office and digital tools.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Ability to work autonomously, anticipate needs and take initiative.
• High level of discretion and a proactive mindset.
• Fluency in French, Dutch and English.
